name: Ontario Address Change Tracker
notes: This repo. One snapshot per dataset per day; measures read data/<slug>/<slug>.db

name: OpenAddresses
access: public API; outputs need a login
notes: One JSON per source; batch.openaddresses.io runs them weekly and publishes per-job counts and field stats. Point outputs are behind authentication, so OA is measured per source, not per municipality

name: StatCan Open Database of Addresses
notes: 99 providers (39 Ontario), all pulled Jan-Apr 2021, never refreshed. Data_Sources.csv inside ODA_ON_v1.zip is the provider table

name: StatCan National Address Register
notes: Built from the Building Register; CSD_ENG_NAME per address. Vintages archived under prototype-nar/data (202412, 202507, 202606); older ones 404

name: Overture Maps addresses theme
notes: Canada comes from the NAR via OpenAddresses (sources[1].dataset = ca/countrywide). address_levels[2] is the postal municipality, not the census subdivision, so points are binned by polygon
